title: raw/capture.json (written by the recorder, read by the packager)
description: Recorder session summary. Every field is optional for the packager: older recordings without the v0.2 fields still package (capture_mode from source, cursor_in_video false, capture_rect from source + screens).

status.description: completed: the recorder stopped normally. Any other status means it did not finish: while raw/.recording.lock is held (recorder.reclock, K11) the session is still recording and the packager refuses it; once the lock is free (crash, power loss, killed process, or a recording made before v0.2.1 without the lock file) validation accepts the session as recovered after an abnormal stop, with a warning, when the clip decodes and its frame count matches.

capture_rect.description: Virtual-screen pixels shown by the video. Desktop mode = the primary monitor (v0.2.1: single display); app mode = the captured monitor (origin may be negative on multi-monitor desktops). Every segment of a recording has this same rectangle and size. Validation requires the video size to equal width x height (an odd width or height cropped by 1 px to an even size is tolerated) for desktop/monitor/app.

cursor_in_video.description: OS cursor drawn into the video (Markov style).

overlay_allow.description: --app-overlay-allow: extra exe names (lower case) whose full-screen click-through overlay windows (transparent HUDs) are left visible in app mode instead of being painted black, besides the built-in GPU overlay list.

policy_pauses.description: Privacy pauses because a blocklisted app (password manager) came to the front (trigger policy_blocked_app, any mode); their time is cut from the video.

ffmpeg.description: FFmpeg used for recording; the packager reuses it (and its sibling ffprobe) and falls back to recorder.paths.

packager.description: Written by the packager into the package's capture.json (not by the recorder).

segment_repairs.description: Segments whose FFmpeg did not finish normally (raw/segments.json broken / in_progress / finalized false): reason broken | unreadable | untimed (left out; its time is a gap), truncated | trimmed (only the decodable start is used), extended (frames encoded after the last sidecar save got nominal frame times), complete (probed and used as listed). Whether a capture whose status is not 'completed' counts as recovered does not depend on this list (see status, K11).

preroll_from_ms.description: Set when segments before the first clip were left out: input before this wall time is not in the video (validation does not require it in the frame log).

recording_lock.description: K11: true when the recorder held raw/.recording.lock (recorder.reclock) while recording; false when it could not take it (folder not writable or locked elsewhere), so a crash cannot be told from a live session and a non-completed status is treated as recovered.
